name: oc-ai-report
description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period - reads the AI-metrics JSON records (backend, frontend, QA) from Jira, shows a summary by user then details per user by ticket plus totals by area, and adds each ticket's original estimate, Tempo-logged time, time gain, and linked-bug count. Read-only; needs only the Atlassian (Jira) MCP.
